name: Dhiman Saikia
message:
🚌 Final Project Plan: Smart Bus Service System
1️⃣ Features & Functionalities
👑 Admin

Single super-admin account.

Dashboard with system overview:

Total enrolled students, drivers, moderators.

Bus routes, capacity, driver assignments.

User Management:

Create/update/delete moderators, drivers, students.

Reset credentials.

Bus Management:

Add/edit buses with route IDs, road names, capacity.

Notifications:

Send announcements (holidays, bus repair, reassignments) to selected bus members only.

Analytics (later with Supabase sync):

Usage reports, attendance trends, overloaded routes.

🛠 Moderator

Register students, drivers, and assign them to buses.

Manage bus routes and capacity planning.

Approve/reject driver swaps.

Access bus status in real time (location, attendance logs).

👨‍✈️ Driver

Default assigned bus, option to swap with another driver.

Live map → see students who have set “waiting flag”.

Boarding verification:

Student profile photo appears.

Driver confirms
